headline: Corona Capital will leave 758 million pesos in economic impact in Mexico City: Canaco
summary: The Canaco business chamber estimates the Corona Capital festival will draw 255,000 attendees and generate 758 million pesos for hotels, restaurants, shops and transport services in Mexico City.
why: Large events drive short-term spending in hospitality, retail and transport, which is a relevant economic effect for local service businesses.
original_headline: Corona Capital dejará derrama de 758 millones de pesos en la CDMX: Canaco
